The default.xbe on this disc is not the exact file this build needs (%1$s): every byte of it is checked.

Most often it is a modified copy. Softmods, hard-disk loaders and trainers patch a few bytes of default.xbe and keep the original beside it, as default.bak or default.xbe.bak. If the folder has one: move the patched default.xbe out of the folder, rename default.bak to default.xbe, and choose the folder again.

If it is the disc of another region or the demo, it needs the build made for that disc; this one is for %1$s.
